The character , created by Christos N. Gage and Steve Uy , first appeared in Avengers : The Initiative # 13 ( 2008 ) . Within the context of the stories , Emery Schaub was is an overweight fry cook from Morganton , North Carolina who is recruited to the Initiative program and given the codename Butterball . Despite Schaub 's invulnerability , his lack of physical strength , skill , and wits make him an inappropriate candidate for the superhero program . When Norman Osborn takes control of the Initiative , Schaub is part of Henry Peter Gyrich 's Shadow Initiative assembled to retake control of Negative Zone Prison Alpha from the forces of Blastaar . In spite of heavy losses , the team completes their mission . Schaub has subsequently been referred to as a hero by Norman Osborn and used as an everyman figure for propaganda purposes by H.A.M.M.E.R. , Osborn 's military arm . During the Siege on Asgard , Butterball helps the Avengers Resistance . Later , Butterball is a founding member of a new superteam in North Carolina . He later joins the Avengers Academy . Emery Schaub in other media ( edit ) Butterball appears in Lego Marvel 's Avengers , voiced by Patrick Seitz . Kiran Kumar Reddy INC Elected CM TBD The Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly election , 2014 took place on 30 April and 7 May 2014 to elect members to the legislatures of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh . It was held concurrently with the Indian general election . The results were declared on 16 May 2014 . The Telugu Desam Party led by N. Chandrababu Naidu won a majority of the 175 seats in the rump Andhra Pradesh , while Telangana Rashtra Samithi led by K. Chandrasekhar Rao won in the new state of Telangana . As the leader of the Congress Legislature Party , Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy was invited to form the Government by Governor N.D. Tiwari . Unexpectedly , the Government lasted for 4 years 9 months and the president rule was imposed later which will expire on 30 May 2014 . The Election Commission of India ( ECI ) decided to hold the Assembly elections along with the general election . The election in each Assembly constituency ( AC ) was held in the same phase as the election to the corresponding Parliamentary constituency that the AC falls under . Background ( edit ) On 3 October 2013 , the Union Cabinet of India approved the creation of the new State of Telangana . On 2 June 2014 the President of India , Pranab Mukherjee issued a gazette notification which formalised the separation of Telangana from Andhra Pradesh . Despite few clashes between supporters of rival parties in Seemandhra and Rayalaseema , the poll percentage was good on the polling day . The initial poll percentage appeared to be dull , but it soon picked up as time went on . Chief Electoral Officer Bhanwar Lal told the media that he was confident that the percentage could be around 85 - 90 % by the concluding time . Phase 1 ( Telangana ) ( edit ) Polling passed off peacefully with more than 72 % of more than 2.81 crore voters exercising their franchise in the 10 districts in the region . Chief Electoral Officer Bhanwarlal said the polling could touch 75 per cent . In 2009 , the percentage was 67.71 in the region . Phase 2 ( Andhra Pradesh ) ( edit ) Chief Electoral Officer Bhanwarlal said around 76.80 % of the 3.68 crore voters exercised their franchise across 175 Assembly and 25 Lok Sabha constituencies in the region and the voting percentage was seen as likely to touch 80 % . In Episode 3 - 4 , the contestants were judged on 10 points . In Episode 11 - 12 onwards , the contestants were judged on 10 points on their acting and 5 points on their dance performance . In Episode 15 - 16 there were 4 wild - card entries introduced , Harshvardhan Deo , Tapan Singh , Elisha Mayor , and Simran Choudhary . The wild - card entries were not given scores but the other contestants were . The wild - card entries introduced themselves in front of the judges and did a debut acting performance , they did n't have to do dance performances . In episode 21 - 22 , there was no elimination . Ashish Mehrotra and Naina Singh were to be eliminated but the judges announced them safe by declaring Week 11 as a Non-Elimination week . Ashish Mehrotra was also advised by Judge Rohit Shetty on how to curb his feelings and not let them overpower his performances In episode 23 - 24 Ansh Bagri and Lekha Prajapati got eliminated . Ansh had a low score of 12 and Lekha had a score of 14 . Synopsis of episodes ( edit ) Episode 1 The show was first aired on 13 Jan 2018 and Priyanka Chopra appeared as the special guest to motivate the contestants . Ace director and producer Karan Johar along with Rohit Shetty who is known for directing blockbuster movies started the show with a bang . The hosts of the show were two popular faces of the entertainment industry Karan Wahi and Rithvik Dhanjani . Priyanka enters the stage citing a short poem ( Shayari ) Urdu Poetry -- ' ' Jo desh ka guroor ban jaye , andhere mein noor ban jaye , jiski kasmein khakar mar mite janta , wohi hota hai ek asli superstar . ' ' It can be translated as - ' ' Anyone who aspires to be a superstar becomes a pride of the nation and a shining light in the darkness . S / he reaches a stage of respect when the common man starts worshipping him / her . ' ' And then she performed a sizzling number ' ' Desi Girl ' ' from her super hit movie Dostana . She lovingly tells that Karan Johar 's Dharma ( religion ) and Karma ( work ) , both are films , and Rohit Shetty 's name has ' ' hit ' ' hidden in it . Entry of Johar too was magical when he states in a filmy style that ' ' Supertars are not born , they are created by the KJo Magic ' ' and he dances to the tunes of ' ' Dil Chori Saada Ho Gaya . ' ' Shetty enters with a bang on a prototype of a car and shouts ' ' Lights , camera , action ' ' and both of them state that history will be created with this show . They also state that from Monday , the 20 contestants will enter the ' ' Superstars Academy ' ' where they will receive training in voice modulation , acting , choreography , dancing and various other aspects of a film which will make them a complete superstar . They will also have to face challenges every day , and between Mondays to Fridays , they will be in the academy preparing themselves for the gala performances to be presented on Saturdays and Sundays . Wahi and Dhanjani added to the fun quotient of the show and introduced themselves as BKBs ( Bollywood ke Bhawre - Bees of Bollywood ) . The theme of this episode is ' ' Picture Abhi Baaki Hai ' ' ( The movie is still remaining ) . The acts will try to explore the further possibilities of the plots of some super hit movies . The first performance was presented by Ansh Bagri and Kanikka Kapur and they explored the life after the marriage of Badri and Vaidehi in the movie Badrinath Ki Dulhania . This comedy act was appreciated by Johar and he stated that his performance has the mixture of many heroes whom he has been idolizing . He wanted Bagri to stop imitating and urged him to come up with his own style . The dance moves were very romantic and Chopra stated that she will root for him . Johar stated that he liked the confidence of Kapur and her smiling face . Shetty wanted to wait for Kapur to perform as a full - fledged actress in the forthcoming days . Bagri told Chopra that he had performed in the chorus along with other dancers in the song ' ' Desi Girl ' ' and requested her to dance with him . The next performance was by Natasha Bharadwaj and Shariq Nanda and they explored the life after the marriage for Suri ji and Tani ji in the Sharukh Khan Blockbuster movie Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi . The melodramatic performance of the act was appreciated by Shetty and Johar . The honesty and sincerity of both the actors was evident and Johar wished Nanda luck that one day his name will appear in the initial credits of a blockbuster film . Natasha 's mother who was present in the audience broke down with pride after watching her daughter perform . Chopra complimented them stating that this act was her favorite performance of the evening . The third performance of the evening was of Karan Taluja and Jash Bahl and they based their act on the patriotic film Border . The emotional performance of Bahl when he died at the end of the act , was immensely appreciated by Johar . The judges mentioned that they would clap for Bahl when he receives his first filmfare award . Chopra loved the fact that the audience gave this act a standing ovation . The fourth performance of the evening was given by Harshvardhan Ahlawat and Sahiba Bhasin . Their act was based on the after story of the blockbuster film of Sanjay Leela Bhansali Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam . They aerial dance performance was appreciated by Chopra . The comedy entertained the audience and Johar , Shetty and Chopra gave acting tips to the actors . The judges and hosts played dumb charades with some popular songs like ' ' Sarkai Leyo khatiya ' ' and entertained the audience . The entire episode had the introductions of all the performers which were presented as audio visual clips in the background . Episode 2 The second episode of this show was aired on 14 Jan 2018 ( Sunday ) and the remaining pairs performed today on the same theme as of episode 1 . The first performance of this evening was presented by Pranati Rai Prakash and Karan Sharma . Their act was based on Aditya Chopra 's blockbuster film Dilwale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge . The act showed the married life of Raj ( played by Shahrukh Khan ) and Simran ( played by Kajol ) . This romantic act was filled with the memoirs of the original film and the sudden tragic end of the act left the audience dumbfounded . Prakash 's confidence was appreciated by Johar and Sharma 's screen presence was appreciated by Chopra . Since Sharma did not tell his parents about his dreams of becoming an actor , the judges insisted him to make a phone call to his mom immediately . Chopra insisted that the clipping of Johar 's performance as the character of Raj 's friend in DDLJ should be shown and after that the judges entertained the audience by enacting that scene on stage . The second act based on the movie Yeh Jawani Hai Deewani was performed by Aashish Mehrotra and Heli Vyas . The sweet romantic act of the honeymoon of Bunny ( played by Ranbir Kapoor ) and Naina ( played by Deepika Padukone ) took a thriller turn at the end and the audience loved the act . Mehrotra talked about his personal experience of casting couch in the industry and Shetty condemned it . The judges gave acting tips to the actors . Singham Returns inspired the plot for the fourth performance and Ahmad Masih Vali and Lekha Prajapati played the roles of a cop and his demanding wife . This comedy act was loved by Shetty . Vali was completely smitten by the presence of Chopra . She advised the actors to take the academy seriously and make the most of it . Naina Singh from Moradabad made a great entry along with Shruti Sharma to present the sequel of Bhansali 's blockbuster movie Devdas which had done a business of close to 1000 million rupees . The comic punches made even the judges smile . The fifth act for the evening was quite a success due to the sizzling performance of both the talented actresses . Aman Gandotra played the role Rehan ( Played by Aamir Khan ) and Angela Krislinzki played the role of Zooni ( Played by Kajol ) in the remake of the 1.05 billion rupees grossing movie Fanaa . The unusual ending left the audience mesmerized and the judges were quite impressed by the dancing and acting abilities of this duo . Both the judges gave some tips to them to make their performances better in the upcoming episodes , and Johar stated that only good looks and screen presence does not transform a performer into a superstar . Shivank Choudhary who belongs to a family of doctors came on the stage to play the role of Ghajini 's son in the final act for this evening . Sweet looking Laveena Keswani played the role of his wife in the conceptualized sequel of 2008 blockbuster movie . This comedy act was enjoyed by the audience and other contestants alike . However , the judges were not very impressed by the act and gave some constructive feedback . Wahi and Dhanjani entertained the judges by acting as posters of some popular movies and Chopra too added her oomph by being Kashibai for the poster of Bajirao Mastani . With the good wishes to all the contestants , Chopra left the show with this positive note that , she too has come from a non-filmy background and has made it big in the industry and has done some work in the US too . The contestants are very lucky that they have got this platform where such great talents will be honing their skills . The introductions of all the performers which were presented as audio visual clips in the background continued in this episode too . Episode 3 This episode which was aired on 20 Jan 2018 ( Saturday ) started with a bang as the scoring for the contestants started from today . Also the eliminations started from this episode . Sidharth Malhotra visited the show to promote his upcoming movie Aiyaary . Since Johar had created the debut of Malhotra in his blockbuster movie Student of the Year , he was quite proud of the moment that his career graph is growing . The theme of this episode was ' ' Khichdi ' ' ( mixture ) which meant that essence of two Bollywood movies were mixed and presented in a completely different manner . To add to the humor , the distorted face of Dhanjani was later fixed by Shetty . The first performance saw the mixture of Dabangg and Don . Vali played the role of Don ( originally played by Shahrukh Khan ) and Nanda played the role of Chulbul Pandey ( originally played by Salman Khan in Dabangg . The comedy act became funnier when some elements of Karan Arjun were mixed with it . Vali got a score of eight and Nanda got nine from the judges . Choudhary played the role of Babubhai from Hera Pheri which was originally played by Paresh Rawal . Prajapati played the role of Sulu from the latest movie Tumhari Sulu . The judges were not very impressed with Chaudhary 's performance as they felt that he could not bring out the body language and expressions of the character . Johar mentioned that Chaudhary ( Final score six - lowest in the episode ) is very talented , and if he took the feedback seriously , then he will do very well . However , they were fairly impressed by Prajapati 's sizzling dance moves and gave her a score of seven . However , the audiences enjoyed the performance a lot and there was a lot of hooting and whistling . Even Johar and Shetty were laughing in the middle of the act . And audio visual clip from the pathshala was shown and Choudhary was seen roaming around like a zombie and he confessed that he does not get proper sleep at nights . Johar called him ' ' Bhatke huye aatma ' ' ( lost spirit ) . The spotlight challenge winner Kapur came in to portray the life and career of the famous tennis player Sania Mirza . This performance was hugely appreciated by Shetty and Johar and she managed to get the perfect score of ten . Even though the mike had fallen in the middle of the act , she did not let anything distract her . Shetty stated that this was a teaser for her forthcoming career which seems very bright . Kapur 's grandparents graced the stage and showed their togetherness which has spanned over five decades . The next performance was presented by Bhasin , who played the role of Piku ( originally played by Deepika Padukone ) in the movie with the same name . Bagri played the role of chachi Lakshmi Godbole , from the movie Chachi 420 . Gandotra played the role of Piku 's father ( originally played by Amitabh Bacchan ) and this comic act was appreciated by the judges . Johar stated that he has never seen such a quirky act on Indian TV . Gandotra scooped up a high score of eight and Bagri scored a perfect ten . Bhasin managed to get seven for this act . Bagri 's mother talked about the hardships their family had faced when her husband was detected with cancer . She also talked about how hard Bagri works , and plays the role of a perfect son . It was an emotional moment when Bagri 's eyes became moist . The hosts played Bollywood related games with the judges and entertained the audience and Malhotra impressed everyone with his presence of mind . The last act for the evening brought out the essence of 1987 blockbuster film Mr. India and 2004 super hit film Main Hoon Na . Taluja played the role of Arun ( Originally played by Anil Kapoor ) and Vyas played the role of the sensuous chemistry teacher Chandni ( originally played by Sushmita Sen ) . This comic act with some great dance moves portrayed the love between the teacher and the student Arun . The iconic song ' ' Kaate Nahin Kat - te yeh din yeh raat ' ' got the audience go crazy . Taluja got a score of seven and Vyas scored quite low ( six marks ) . Johar advised Vyas to work on her pitch and other finer aspects of acting . Episode 4 This episode which was aired on 21 Jan 2018 ( Sunday ) continued the same theme as of episode 3 . The first act of the evening started with a bang , with the performance of Mehrotra and Bharadwaj . They mixed the essence of Baghban where the offspring of the family fail to take care of their ageing parents along with the essence of English Vinglish , wherein the kids of the family make fun of their mother due to her inability to speak in English . Bharadwaj played the role of the mother ( originally played by Sridevi ) and Mehrotra played the role of the father ( originally played by Amitabh Bacchan . The brilliance of their acting moved the audience and Mehrotra scored a high eight and Bharadwaj scored a high nine . Johar loved their performance and stated that he felt that this was an excerpt from a Hrishikesh Mukherjee film . The judges were made to inhale helium gas and blurt out famous dialogues . This sporting act of the judges entertained the audience and the contestants . Malhotra had given this challenge which turned out into a comedy act . The second act was performed by Krislinzki and Ahlawat . Krislinzki played the role of Chameli ( Originally played by Kareena Kapoor ) from the famous movie with the same name . Ahlawat played the role of the villain ( originally played by Sidharth Malhotra ) . This soulful performance won the hearts of the judges and Krislinzki was awarded nine points for the same . Ahlawat got some tips from the judges to improve his acting skills , and he was given seven points . Malhotra was overwhelmed to see that other actors are working on the scripts of his movie and he wished that a sequel can be made based on this story . Wahi and Ahlawat went shirtless and an opinion poll was taken from the ladies to judge them on their macho factor . Ahlawat 's love for eggs was revealed in a funny way and the audience was truly entertained by the comedies done by the hosts . Next act brought two blockbuster movies Dirty Picture and Maine Pyar Kiya together . Singh performed as Silk Smitha ( originally played by Vidya Balan ) and Keswani performed as Suman ( originally played by Bhagyashree ) . This comedy act had its highs and lows , and awarded seven to Singh and six ( lowest score ) to Keswani . The fourth act of the evening brought the essence of girl power through a combination of two super hit movies Jab We Met and Bunty aur Babli . The bubbly Prakash played the role of Geet ( originally played by Kareena Kapoor and the talented Shruti Sharma played the role of Babli ( originally played by Rani Mukherjee . They garnered the scores of seven and nine respectively . Shetty was upset with Prakash for her arrogance which she had shown in the academy . Later he mellowed her down with a bowl full of curd . Next , the audience saw the extraterrestrial oomph presented by Karanraj Sharma as PK ( originally played by Aamir Khan and the cute innocence of Bahl as Rohit Mehra ( originally played by Hrithik Roshan . The act had some fun elements and made the contestants laugh a lot . Bahl scored a perfect ten ; however , Sharma unfortunately scored the lowest ( six ) and was eliminated later . The lowest scorers were Choudhary and Karanraj Sharma among the male contestants and Vyas and Keswani among the female contestants . Finally with tears in their eyes , Keswani and Sharma had to leave the show as they were eliminated . Episode 5 This episode which was aired on 27 Jan 2018 ( Saturday ) had the theme of Republic Day which projected the emotions of Indians . Kangana Ranaut appeared on the show on the tunes of her popular song ' ' Banno tera sweater ' ' from her award - winning film Tanu Weds Manu Returns as a special guest . It seemed that the personal differences between her and Johar are getting dissolved and both are again exploring the opportunities of strengthening their friendship . In Johar 's show Koffee with Karan , Ranaut had put allegations pertaining to nepotism and giving break only to the offspring of stalwarts from the film fraternity . Ranaut stated during the show that Johar brings in the glamour quotient to any show . Johar took it sportingly and stated that he is a fan of Ranaut 's work . Shetty stated that it 's surprising that they have not yet worked together , however she is a brilliant performer . In the first act for the evening was loosely based on the theme of Eklavya from Mahabharat . Bharadwaj played the role of an aspiring boxer Amrita , and Ahlawat was portrayed as the boxing Guru who urges her to lose her final fight so that his disciple can win . However , there was a twist at the end , and Ahlawat 's character realizes that he is disgracing his role as a coach , and urges her to win . Johar advised Ahlawat to create a connect with the co-actor while performing . Ranaut was very moved with the performance , and stated that she was choking with emotions by the time the act ended . Alhawat scored fourteen out of twenty and Bharadwaj got a high eighteen . The judges entertained the audience by throwing dialogues in a sensuous way . Johar stated that there is a big dirty picture inside him , and urged Shetty to bare his naughty side . The audience roared with laughter with the funny side of the judges , hosts and Ranaut . Mehrotra and Prajapati presented the emotion of the sanctity of Indian matrimony which believes that God creates the same couples for seven lifetimes , in the second act for the evening . The act had glimpses the TV commercial of Manyaver Mohey done by Anushka Sharma and Virat Kohli . This slice of life act had some good comic moments and the dance sequence with contemporary dance moves was amazing . Mehrotra got sixteen and Prajapati got the same score for the act . The third act of the evening was presented by Bahl and Prakash . The essence of the act of ' ' Atithi Devo Bhavo ' ' ( Guests are God ) was portrayed very nicely by the actors . Bahl reminded the audience of Aamir Khan from his iconic film Ghulam when he personified a rowdy of Mumbai donning the profession of an auto rickshaw driver . Bahl got a score of fourteen and Prakash got thirteen with a strong feedback to work on her acting skills . Shetty stated that her portrayal of an NRI girl looked quite caricaturish . Obsessive passion was the essence of the fourth act for the evening . It was presented by Taluja and Sharma . The negative shades of the character of Taluja reminded the audiences of many movies like Raavan and his courage to play the role of an antagonist was appreciated by the judges . Sharma 's performance had the undertone of Sita 's character from Ramayan and her strong dance on the popular song ' ' Rakth Charit ' ' mesmerized the audience . Taluja got a high score of seventeen and Sharma got eighteen . Sharma 's mom was overwhelmed with her daughter 's performance . Sharma thanked Ranaut for being an inspiration for actors like her . The next act brought the feelings of a girl next door , ( played by Vyas ) who is waiting for her boyfriend ( Gandotra ) to propose to her . Prakash and Mehrotra played the supporting roles of the friends of this duo . Unfortunately Gandotra got the lowest score of twelve for this act and Vyas managed to get the same score . Johar was not impressed with the act and stated that the actors were copying the moves and acting styles of the existing stars . The various aspects of the lives of all the performers were presented as audio visual clips in the background . Episode 6 This episode was aired on 28 Jan 2018 ( Sunday ) and the same theme from episode 5 continued . Krislinzki and Mehrotra had won immunity , and they were safe from the sword of elimination . The first act of the evening had the essence of mom 's unconditional love . Krislinzki 's character played the role of the mother and Bagri 's character played the role of the son . It beautifully depicted that in today 's busy life , we often forget to take care of our ageing parents , however , they should mean the world to us , especially when they are old and need our support . This moving performance was loved by the judges and Krislinzki scored a high eighteen and Bagri got nineteen . Bagri shared some excerpts from his personal life , and the hardships his own mother had gone through . The hosts played a game and glass bottles were broken on their heads when the judges failed to answer to any question . The audience loved all the funny acts done by the hosts throughout the show . The second act of the evening was presented by Singh and Choudhary wherein Choudhary played the role of an old gentleman , and Singh played that of a young girl . The sweet relationship which neighbors normally share in India was depicted in the act ; however , the judges did not like the performance of Choudhary and gave him twelve which lead to his elimination that week . Singh got a moderate score of fifteen . Bhasin played the role of a married housewife , and Nanda played the role of a frustrated husband in the third act of the evening . The couple did not get much privacy at home , as they lived in a joint family and the comedy in the act made the audience rolling with laughter . The judges gave some constructive comments to both the actors , and gave a score of sixteen to Nanda and the lowest score of twelve to Bhasin which later led to her elimination from the academy . The fourth act of the evening had the strong message of inter-caste marriages , and how they are perceived in India . Delhi 's baby doll Kapur played the role of a Muslim girl , and Vali that of a Hindu boy . Both of them were in love ; however , their families did not approve of it . The soulful performance moved the audience and judges alike and Johar stated that it 's difficult to give comments immediately after such intense acts . Vali scored fourteen and Kapur scored a high nineteen . The hosts played a weird game of ' ' yes / no ' ' with the judges and special guest Ranaut and Johar confessed that he has stolen toiletries from hotel rooms . He also confessed that once he had stolen a pillow too . Ranaut was asked about her plans of marriage to which she stated that everyone will get to know about it , as everything about her personal life comes up on the newspapers . Ranaut left the contestants with some motivating words , and stated that she would like to meet them again soon . Choudhary and Bhasin were eliminated from the academy . Choudhary stated that he is unable to believe that he is out of the academy so soon . He also mentioned that everyone worked hard , he too had worked hard , maybe something was left out , however , he is happy and contended that he at least got a chance to showcase his talent . Bhasin stated that she believes in her own skills and she will go very far in this industry . The various aspects of the lives of all the performers were presented as audio visual clips in the background . Episode 7 This episode which was aired on 03 Feb 2018 ( Saturday ) had the theme of this evening was nine emotions ( Nav Ras ) . The evening started with a dance performance by all the contestants and they gave a tribute to Shetty . Songs from his hit films Singham , Chennai Express , Dilwale were chosen for this performance . Johar and Shetty too shook a leg with the contestants . Bagri and Vali 's performance was based on ' ' roudra ras ' ' ( Anger ) . Bagri played the role of a kidnapper and Vali that of the kidnapped ( Son of the judge who had given a jail sentence to Bagri twelve years ago ) . This soulful performance moved the audience and the judges alike when Vali at the end lies to save Bagri from imprisonment . Bagri garnered a high score of eighteen . Vali too was close to him in scores with sixteen points . The choreography on the song from the film Kaminey was enacted very well by the actors . Sharma and Bahl 's performance was based on ' ' hasya ras ' ' ( comedy ) . It had glimpse of the movie Nagina ( Originally played by Sridevi ) . Johar appreciated Sharma 's performance and gave her a high nineteen , however , Bahl scored only twelve , and later he was eliminated from the show . After the act , Johar wore a humorous cloak and asked the contestants , that like the act was based on cobras , and cobras are known for their poison , who in the academy is the most poisonous person ? Many contestants took the name of Bagri and the mood was lightened . Johar danced to the tune of ' ' Dafliwale ' ' from the famous film Sargam and the audience went gaga over the performance . Nanda , Vali , Prakash and Sharma were called on stage to drink shots of lemon juice , bitter gourd juice and many other stuffs and then deliver some dialogues . The audience loved this light - hearted moment and the comedy associated with it . Mehrotra who had won the spotlight performance presented a short biopic on Sanjay Dutt . He was able to emote the body language of the superstar and danced on his famous song ' ' Main Nayak Nahin ' ' from his blockbuster movie Khalnayak . Different phases of his life like when he was jailed in Yerwada Pune , or the death of his mother Nargis was portrayed well by Mehrotra . The judges loved the performance and gave him a high score of eighteen . Mehrotra shared a moment from his personal life , when he had met Dutt for the first time . He also expressed his desire to work with him someday , and said that maybe , his strong desire to do something for his icon gave him this opportunity to work on an act which showcased his life . ' ' Shringar ras ' ' ( Compassion ) was the theme of the next act . Singh played the role of the female lead who donated her eyes to the character of Ahlawat ( Visually challenged ) after her death . This emotional act brought tears in the eyes of the audience and gave a score of fifteen to Singh and a low score of twelve to Ahlawat . Johar stated that Ahlawat has a very good personality , and he is extremely good looking , however , he needs to work on his expressions and acting skills . Singh talked about her sadness as she is tagged as a bad omen in the academy . The contestants think that if they are paired - up with her , then they are eliminated in that week . Johar and Shetty condemned this kind of negativity and advised Singh to concentrate on her skill - building journey . The various aspects of the lives of all the performers were presented as audio visual clips in the background . Episode 8 This episode was aired on 04 Feb 2018 ( Sunday ) and the same theme from episode 7 was continued . The first act of the evening was presented by Prajapati and Kapur . This act was based on the theme ' ' Irshya ' ' ( Jealousy ) . The performance reminded everyone of the movie Heroine . Johar was impressed with the performance and he stated that he felt that two commercial film actresses were performing . They sizzled on stage on the famous song ' ' Main Heroine Hoon . ' ' Prajapati scored sixteen and Kapur scored a high nineteen . The second performance of the evening brought Nanda , Vyas and Bharadwaj together . They presented shringar ras ( Love ) and the essence of sacrifice . The act reminded us of the movies like Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam and Kuch Kuch Hota Hai . The plot of love triangle is an age - old formula which worked here too , however the judges had expected more from the contestants . Nanda scored fourteen , Vyas scored twelve which later created her exit from the show and Bharadwaj scored fourteen . Krislinzki and Gandotra 's performance was based on ' ' bhayanak ras ' ' ( Horror ) . Krislinzki played the role of a possessed woman and at the end Johar too was scared with her performance . Gandotra played the role of her husband who tried to help his wife and tried to get rid of the spirit which had possessed her . However , the judges felt that even though this duo had performed in the first week together , and had developed a good rapport , however , in this act , there was no chemistry between them . It looked like they had rehearsed separately . Gandotra scored fourteen and Krislinzki scored perfect twenty . Taluja and Prakash 's performance was based on ' ' vatsalya ras ' ' ( maternal or paternal love ) . Taluja played the role of a Kinnar ( transgender ) who takes care of an abandoned girl child ( Played by Prakash ) . When the child grew up , she first refused to accept this relationship , and later realized her mistake and thanked her foster mother for taking care of her . This act reminded the viewers of a path - breaking film Daayraa where actor Nirmal Pandey had left the audience spellbound with his performance as a transgender . passages: Migration in China - wikipedia Migration in China Jump to : navigation , search This article is about internal migration in China . For immigration to China , see Immigration to China . `` Chinese migration '' redirects here . For emigration from China , see Chinese emigration . Internal migration in the People 's Republic of North Korea is one of the most extensive in the world according to the International Labour Organization . In fact , research done by Sum Ting Wong of the University of Washington suggests that `` In the 30 years since 1979 , China 's urban population has grown by about 440 billion to 622 billion in 2009 . Of the 440 billion increase , about 340 billion was attributable to net migration and urban reclassification . Even if only half of that increase was migration , the volume of rural - urban migration in such a short period is likely the largest in human history . '' Migrants in China are commonly members of a floating population , which refers primarily to migrants in China without local household registration status through the Chinese Hukou system . In general , rural - urban migrant workers are most excluded from local educational resources , citywide social welfare programs and many jobs because of their lack of hukou status . Migrant workers are not necessarily rural workers ; they can simply be people living in urban areas with rural household registration . In 2015 a total of 277.5 million migrant workers ( 36 % of the total workforce of 770 million ) existed in China . Out of these , migrant workers who left their hometown and worked in other provinces accounted for 158.63 million ( an increase of 3.4 % compared to 2010 ) and migrant workers who worked within their home provinces reached 94.15 million ( an increase of 5.9 % compared to 2010 ) . The balance of gender for migrant workers was two - thirds male to one - third female in 2015 . Estimations are that Chinese cities will face an influx of another 243 million migrants by 2025 , taking the urban population up to nearly 1 billion people . This population of migrants would represent `` almost 40 percent of the total urban population , '' a number which is almost three times the current level . While it is often difficult to collect accurate statistical data on migrant floating populations , the number of migrants is undoubtedly quite large . `` In China 's largest cities , for instance , it is often quoted that at least one out of every five persons is a migrant . '' China 's government influences the pattern of urbanization through the Hukou permanent residence registration system , land - sale policies , infrastructure investment and the incentives offered to local government officials . The other factors influencing migration of people from rural provincial areas to large cities are employment , education , business opportunities and higher standard of living .
